assignment: Write a scheduling handoff for a fictional clinic moving between buildings. Address access and continuity only.
source: On move day site A can host 18 visits and site B 16. There are 40 confirmed bookings including eight patients who requested step-free entrance. Only site B has a verified step-free route. Ten patients have consented to a remote appointment, but the clinic can host just six remote visits. Four of the ten also requested step-free access. Staff do not know whether the other six remote volunteers can all connect.

criteria.full: Reconciles 34 physical slots plus six remote to 40 and preserves the eight access requests with a feasible assignment or contingency.
criteria.partial: Counts nominal capacity but overlooks the overlap or route constraint.

criteria.full: Uses only consenting remote participants and distinguishes willingness from confirmed connectivity.
criteria.partial: Assumes remote capacity guarantees successful visits.

criteria.full: Specifies timely connectivity checks, callback ownership and what to do if fewer than six remote conversions are confirmed.
criteria.partial: Notes a remote risk without recovering unmet capacity.

criteria.full: Provides an accessible confirmation or location notice and tracks failed transfers or unfilled appointments.
criteria.partial: Suggests reminders without addressing accessibility or transfer outcomes.
